title: Content contract
description: The shape of GET /api/site.json and of site.content in the host API (docs/frontend-protocol.md, 'Content contract'). Front ends depend on this, never on the CMS schema. Evolution is additive only: never remove or retype a property, never make a property newly required (new fields are optional here even though the server always sends them). internal/contract's compatibility test enforces this against content-contract.v<contractVersion>.snapshot.json.

contractVersion.description: Major version of this contract. Changes only with a breaking change.

pages.description: Published CMS pages, ordered by slug (home first). Keyed by slug.

experiments.description: Published experiments, in their CMS order. Keyed by slug.

projects.description: Since v1.4. Published projects (client work, shown at the route "work/<slug>"), in their featured order. Keyed by slug. Always sent; optional here only because v1 didn't have it.

slug.description: The page's path without slashes; "" is the home page.

body.description: Plain text; paragraphs separated by blank lines. May be "".

link.description: Since v1.4 (always sent). Where the piece lives: an absolute http(s) URL, or "". Open it with site.openExternal. Never generated.

media.description: Since v1.4 (always sent). Stills and loops, in order; may be empty.

slug.description: The project's page is the route "work/<slug>".

client.description: Plain text, e.g. "Samsung". May be "". Never generated.

agency.description: Plain text; the agency Ben made it with, or "". Never generated.

year.description: As written, e.g. "2020". May be "". Never generated.

roles.description: Ben's roles ("Creative Director"); may be empty.

summary.description: Plain text; paragraphs separated by blank lines. May be "".

contribution.description: Plain text: what Ben did on it. May be "". Never generated.

body.description: Plain text; paragraphs separated by blank lines. May be "". Never generated.

link.description: The live work: an absolute http(s) URL, or "". Open it with site.openExternal. Never generated.

palette.description: The project's colours as lowercase "#rrggbb"; may be empty.

youtube.description: A YouTube video id (11 characters), or "". Its page is https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>; open it with site.openExternal. Never generated.

media.description: Stills and loops, in order (the first image is the hero); may be empty.

Since v1.4. One still (kind "image") or one silent loop (kind "loop": an MP4 to play muted, looping, inline, with a still poster). src and poster are root-relative paths under /media/, served by both the main site and the user-content origin (same-origin for front ends, so img-src/media-src 'self' allow them). Every key is always sent.

kind.description: "image" or "loop"; skip kinds you don't know.

src.description: The image, or the loop's MP4: a path starting with /media/.

width.description: Intrinsic width in px; 0 if unknown.

height.description: Intrinsic height in px; 0 if unknown.

alt.description: Alternative text, or "" (then describe it from the item, e.g. its title).

generated.description: Names of this item's fields whose values were generated by the site observer rather than written by a person.

extra.description: An extra field (usually observer-generated, then listed in _generated). Front ends must read extra fields with site.field and a fallback.
